source_facts.fact: NPPF requires Mineral Safeguarding Areas and Mineral Consultation Areas while explicitly avoiding a presumption that safeguarded resources will be worked.
source_facts.gate: MSA intersection is not extraction permission or proof the resource will be worked.

source_facts.fact: Mineral planning authorities should use best available information and local plan policies to safeguard resources; prior extraction may be encouraged where practical.
source_facts.gate: Safeguarding policy is not a parcel reserve estimate or automatic prior-extraction requirement.

source_facts.fact: The national Planning Data MSA dataset currently reports 0 records, 0 providers and no collector attempt, with unknown origin.
source_facts.gate: No national service record must be recorded as NO_DATA, not no mineral safeguarding constraint.

source_facts.fact: The 2023 Great Britain survey provides sales, flows, consumption and permitted-reserve information for primary aggregates and was published 6 August 2025.
source_facts.gate: National or sub-national aggregate statistics are not parcel reserve or permission values.

source_facts.fact: Minerals guidance describes LAAs as annual assessments using 10-year sales averages plus other local information and all supply options.
source_facts.gate: LAA demand/supply monitoring is not a site allocation or planning permission.

source_facts.fact: MMO guidance says aggregate dredging removes sand and gravel from the seabed for construction and always requires a marine licence.
source_facts.gate: Marine licence requirements and land-use planning permission are separate regimes.

core_rules: Mineral Safeguarding Area is not extraction permission
MSA designation does not presume the resource will be worked
Mineral Consultation Area is a consultation mechanism not a prohibition zone
Planning Data MSA NO_DATA must not become no safeguarding constraint
absence from a national service does not override local minerals plans
BGS resource mapping is not a measured parcel reserve
geological occurrence is not economically workable reserve proof
mineral resource presence does not establish ownership or extraction rights
specific site allocation is not planning permission
preferred area is not planning permission
area of search is not planning permission
prior extraction policy is not an automatic requirement for every proposal
prior extraction feasibility requires proposal and mineral evidence
mineral planning authority advice is not the district planning authority final decision on non-mineral development
local mineral plan policy must retain its adopted date and geography
Local Aggregate Assessment is annual monitoring not a site allocation
10-year sales average is not a forecast for a parcel
aggregate landbank is a monitoring tool not a quarry-life guarantee
low landbank is not automatic permission for a new quarry
crushed-rock and sand-gravel landbanks must remain distinct
Aggregate Working Party advice is not planning permission
national aggregate guidelines are not rigid parcel standards
2023 aggregate survey data are not current parcel reserve estimates
permitted reserve statistics are aggregated and not cadastral geometry
sales statistics do not prove remaining reserve at an individual site
planning permission for mineral extraction is separate from environmental permits
mineral extraction planning permission is separate from land ownership rights
restoration condition is not evidence restoration has occurred
aftercare condition is not evidence aftercare is complete
financial guarantee is not proof restoration performance
industrial-mineral factsheet is not a site resource assessment
construction-aggregate factsheet is not a site feasibility study
BGS factsheet publication date must not be treated as survey date for a parcel
marine aggregate dredging requires marine licensing and is distinct from terrestrial mineral planning
marine licence is not terrestrial planning permission
marine aggregate licence does not establish land-based wharf capacity
aggregate wharf safeguarding is not proof wharf capacity is available
safeguarded rail terminal is not a guaranteed logistics route
Aggregates Levy applicability is a tax matter not an extraction consent
levy registration is not planning permission
commercial exploitation for tax purposes is not the same as planning commencement
recycled aggregate supply must not be treated as a specific site's available capacity without evidence
secondary aggregate statistics must not be downscaled to a parcel
mineral safeguarding and contaminated-land risk must remain distinct
mineral safeguarding and coal-mining risk must remain distinct
NO_DATA must not be converted into no mineral constraint
no parcel mineral reserve extraction permission or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
research-source confidence must not be reported as parcel mineral accuracy
